verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business telephony product, so automatic CRM logging of calls and texts is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions a CRM integration or automatic logging against contacts. The documented integrations are Meet and Calendar, plus BigQuery reporting and the Admin Reports activities API. These are adjacent analytics building blocks, not the product logging calls and texts to a CRM against the right contact.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
